guarantees.claim: msg_valid_o is driven to kmac_valid when en_kmac_datapath is high, otherwise to fifo_valid_i.
msg_data_o is driven to kmac_data when en_kmac_datapath is high, otherwise to fifo_data_i.
msg_strb_o is driven to kmac_strb when en_kmac_datapath is high, otherwise to fifo_strb_i.
fifo_ready_o is forced to 0 when en_kmac_datapath is high, otherwise passes msg_ready_i.
kmac_strb is driven to all-ones when en_key_write is high, otherwise to all-zeros.
kmac_data is driven to key_sliced when en_key_write is high, otherwise to all-zeros.
process_o is driven to kmac_process when kmac_en_i is high, otherwise to process_i.

assumptions.claim: When en_kmac_datapath=0, the external FIFO interface (fifo_valid_i, fifo_data_i, fifo_strb_i, msg_ready_i) must provide valid protocol signals.
assumptions.risk: If FIFO signals are invalid, msg_valid_o, msg_data_o, and msg_strb_o will propagate garbage, and the ready handshake may stall or deadlock.

assumptions.claim: When kmac_en_i=0, process_i must not be asserted while en_key_write=1.
assumptions.risk: If process_i is asserted during a secret key write, process_o will trigger SHA3 hashing prematurely, possibly operating on an incomplete key and leaking secret material.

assumptions.claim: When en_key_write=1, key_sliced must present a valid full-width secret key and must be stable throughout the write.
assumptions.risk: Incorrect key_sliced leads to loading a wrong secret key into the SHA3 engine, breaking cryptographic operations.

uncertain_points.claim: The RTL does not prevent simultaneous assertion of en_kmac_datapath and en_key_write. If both are high, msg_data_o and msg_strb_o expose the secret key (key_sliced) and full strb on the message output.
uncertain_points.risk: Secret key data may be leaked on the output-facing msg_data_o/msg_strb_o interface, breaking confidentiality.

uncertain_points.claim: When kmac_en_i=0, process_i is passed directly to process_o without any gating or interlock against en_key_write. The comment warns about process_i during key write, but no hardware enforcement exists.
uncertain_points.risk: A spurious or malicious assertion of process_i during key write will start SHA3 processing on an empty or partially written message, potentially leading to incorrect hash or secret leakage.
